premises.text: Connected smart-home devices are easily hacked, invading privacy and exposing the rest of the home network and sensitive files
premises.evidence_span: these same criminals are hacking your home and the smart devices

premises.text: Cujo is a plug-and-play smart network gateway that inventories devices and blocks cyber threats on the home network
premises.evidence_span: a little smart device, very powerful, that you connect to your network to keep you safe against all kinds of cyber threats

premises.text: Cujo sends network metadata to the cloud for threat intelligence and machine-learning behavioral models, blocking only anomalous behavior and updating other Cujos in real time
premises.evidence_span: We also use machine learning to build behavioral models of your devices

premises.text: Cujo sells for $99 plus an $8.99 monthly fee for business-level protection of every device on the network
premises.evidence_span: Cujo is for sale for $99 as well as an $8.99 a month fee

domains.name: Cujo gateway and cloud threat intelligence

value.text: Home networks and smart devices kept safe against remote cyber threats
value.evidence_span: the smart way to fight home hacking
